# 1d Provisioning and the server page: contract

**Read first:** [server provisioning](../processes/servers/server-provisioning.md) (all of it), [servers module](../modules/servers.md) (Lifecycle, Server page, Manifest steps and checks, Ports), [VLESS XHTTP](../integrations/vless-xhttp.md) (what `setup.sh` did), [ADR 0007](../adr/0007-agentless-ssh-with-pinned-host-keys.md), [ADR 0012](../adr/0012-secrets-encrypted-root-password-never-stored.md), [jobs](../processes/platform/jobs.md), designs `RP-Server-new`, `RP-Server-provisioning`, `RP-Server-failed`, `RP-Server-overview`, `RP-Servers`, `RP-Phone-server`, the 0c/0e and 1a–1c **As built** notes.

**Done when:** the admin fills in the new-server form (with the live summary and the country suggestion), **Create** reserves the name and starts `servers.provision`, the server page follows its steps and live log, and a successful run leaves the server **active** with health `unknown`, its DNS record, its deployment, its endpoints with connection URIs (copy, reveal, QR); failures leave it **failed** with **Retry** (asking for the root password when needed, offering **Overwrite** after a DNS conflict) and **Activate anyway** after a smoke-test-only failure; a simple server list exists; the ports for other modules exist; every checklist line passes against `serverstest.VPS`; and one real VPS has been provisioned (manual, recorded in As built).

Retire is 1g; redeploy and the lighter operations are 1e; health rounds are 1f. Until 1f, an active server stays `unknown`.

## Decisions

| Topic | Decision | Why |
|---|---|---|
| Form checks | Server side, all at once (`FieldErrors`): IPv4 only; SSH port 1–65535; root password non-empty; no non-retired server has the IP; location exists; template not archived and version exists; parameters valid by type (`email` = `net/mail` single address, `int`, `bool`, `choice` in options, `text` ≤ 10 000, `string` ≤ 1 000, required ones present); Cloudflare token set and the management hostname in an allowed zone (`dns.Driver.Covers`). Nothing is created on any error. | provisioning.md step 3. |
| New location | The Location field has **New location**, which opens 1a's Add-location dialog; on save the field is re-rendered with the new location selected (and `location_touched` set). | provisioning.md step 1. |
| Live summary | `POST /servers/new/summary` (htmx, on change, debounced 300 ms, `hx-params="not root_password"`: the password is posted only by **Create**): the name the server **would** get (`last_number + 1`, labelled "if created now"), both hostnames, the DNS record (`A nl-2.hosts… → IP, DNS only, TTL 60`), endpoints' display names, and form errors that don't need the network. | provisioning.md step 2. |
| Country suggestion | On IP change the summary call also runs `geoip.Lookup` (cached per IP for 10 min in memory). If the result matches a location's country and the admin **has not chosen** a location yet (a hidden `location_touched` field), the response preselects it with "suggested from the IP (NL)". The admin can always change it; a chosen location is never overridden. Several locations with that country → the first by code. | User decision 2026-10-07. |
| Create | One `Write`: `ReserveNumber`, insert the server (`provisioning`, version, params, sealed secret params), enqueue `servers.provision` with `Secrets{"root_password"}`, `ResourceKey server:<id>`, store `provision_job_id`, record `server.created{ip, template_version}`. Redirect to `/servers/<id>`. | |
| Job type | `servers.provision`: queue `provisioning`, `MaxAttempts 1` (a failure is the admin's to retry: retries ask for input), steps `preflight`, `install-access`, `base-bootstrap`, `dns`, `generated-values`, `upload-files`, `install`, `endpoints`, `self-check`, `smoke-test`, `activate`. The manifest's `steps.install` starts with `base-bootstrap`, `upload-files` (1a's step-order rule): those two run as the job steps of the same name, and the job's `install` step runs the rest of the list in order. Payload `{server_id, overwrite_dns}`. | provisioning.md "each step is resumable". |
| OnFailed | In the failing transaction: server → `failed`, `failed_step`, `failed_error` (≤ 2 000 chars); deployment (if any) → `failed`; record `server.provisioning_failed{step, error}`. | |
| OnCancelled | Server → `failed` with `failed_step` = the step that was running, `failed_error = "cancelled"`; deployment (if any) → `failed` with error `cancelled`; record `server.provisioning_failed{step, error: "cancelled", cancelled: true}`. The event's `NotifyIf` skips `cancelled`. The waiting steps (`dns`, `wait-http` inside `install`, `smoke-test`) select on `r.Cancelling()`. | Edge case "Cancel during DNS". |
| SSH as root | `sshx.Hop.Password` (new): when set, the client offers password (and keyboard-interactive answering the password) **instead of** the key. Used only by `preflight` and the first part of `install-access`, `FirstContact: PinOnFirstContact`, subject `server:<id>`. Auth refusal → `"authentication failed"` (permanent). | ADR 0012. |
| Password lifetime | After `install-access` verified the `proxier` login and `sudo -n true`, `r.DeleteSecret("root_password")` in that step. A retry of a failure at `preflight` or `install-access` **always** asks for the password (it replaces any kept one). | provisioning.md rules. |
| install-access on resume | The step starts by trying a key login as `proxier` plus `sudo -n true`. If that works (a crash after `DeleteSecret` but before the step was marked done), the step is done without root. If not and the password is gone, it fails permanently with "the root password is needed again; use Retry". | The step must be idempotent across the password's deletion. |
| Retry | New platform API `jobs.System.RetryWithTx(ctx, tx, id, by, RetryOptions{Payload map[string]any, Secrets map[string]string}) (newID int64, err error)`: like `Retry` (new linked job from the failed step), with a shallow payload patch and secrets added or replaced, inside the caller's transaction. `Retry` becomes `RetryWithTx` with empty options in its own `Write`. The servers handler, in one `Write`: `RetryWithTx`, server back to `provisioning`, `failed_*` cleared, `provision_job_id` = the new job, and the server's `provision` deployment (if one exists) reopened: `state = running`, `job_id` = the new job, `error` and `finished_at` cleared. Without that, a retry that carries `upload-files` over would reach `activate` with no running deployment, and the server would have no current files. | 0c Retry takes no input, and the server's state must change with it. |
| Retry form | `GET /servers/:id/retry`: root password field when `failed_step ∈ {preflight, install-access}`; **Overwrite the existing record** checkbox (shows the conflicting value) when the failure was a `*dns.ConflictError`; nothing else. The version stays the server's. | provisioning.md "after a failure". |
| Deploy user | `proxier`: `useradd -m -s /bin/bash proxier` if missing, `passwd -l proxier`; sudoers via a temp file + `visudo -cf` + `install -m 0440` into `/etc/sudoers.d/proxier`; keys appended to `~proxier/.ssh/authorized_keys` only when missing (`grep -qxF`), dir `700`, file `600`, owner `proxier`. Then a **new** connection as `proxier` with Proxier's key (`Hop.User = "proxier"`, no password) and `sudo -n true`. Every later connection is that one. | provisioning.md step 2. |
| Remote commands | Every command is a function in `servers/remote` returning a string, quoting with a tested `remote.Quote` (single-quote shell quoting). Root commands are `sudo -n …`. Output parsing lives next to each command. | Build README rule. |
| base-bootstrap | As modules/servers.md: drop-in `/etc/ssh/sshd_config.d/00-proxier.conf` (`PasswordAuthentication no`, `KbdInteractiveAuthentication no`, `PermitRootLogin no`), `sshd -t`, reload (`systemctl reload ssh || systemctl reload sshd`), then verify on a **new** connection (key login + `sudo -n true`) while the old connection stays open; on failure remove the drop-in and reload through the old connection, fail the step. `touch ~proxier/.hushlogin`; `apt-get update && apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates openssl ufw` (`DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive`); Docker via `curl -fsSL https://get.docker.com | sudo -n sh` unless `docker compose version` works (logged "Docker already installed, skipped"); `ufw allow <ssh port>/tcp`, each manifest port, `ufw --force enable`. Every sub-step is idempotent. | Resume after a restart re-runs it. |
| ufw and Docker | Docker's published ports bypass ufw; the manifest's ports are opened in ufw anyway so the rule set says what is meant. Recorded in the module doc. | Known Docker behaviour; nothing else listens. |
| Preflight | `cat /etc/os-release` (`ID-VERSION_ID`, e.g. `debian-12`, `ubuntu-24.04`), `uname -m` (`x86_64` → amd64, `aarch64` → arm64) against `requires`; `ss -ltnpH` for each manifest TCP port → "port 443 is in use by nginx (pid 812)". | |
| dns step | `Driver.Ensure(name, ip, server, overwrite_dns)`, insert/refresh `servers_dns_records` (one row per name; a retry updates the row, never a second record), then `Waiter.Wait`. A `ConflictError` fails the step (permanent) with the value. | |
| generated-values | `gen.Ensure` against stored values; insert the missing ones sealed. Registers every value with `Logger.Redact` (all later steps re-register on resume from the stored values). | |
| upload-files | Render (server context), `install -d -o proxier -g proxier` for `dir` and each parent of a file under it, upload each file with its mode (`Client.Upload`, atomic), remove files the server's **current files** (README rule: the latest succeeded deployment with `uploaded = 1`) had and this render doesn't (exact paths under `dir`, `rm -f`), record a `servers_deployments` row (`provision`, `running`, `uploaded = 1`) and its `servers_deployed_files` (sealed). On resume or retry: the server's running `provision` deployment is reused (its files replaced). Shared with 1e (`servers/remote.UploadFiles`). | modules/servers.md `upload-files`. |
| Step kinds | `run`: `sudo -n sh -c 'cd <dir> && <cmd>'`, timeout from the step (default 10 min); exit ≠ 0 fails with the last 20 lines of output. `compose-up`: `sudo -n docker compose --project-directory <dir> up -d --remove-orphans` (+ `pull` first when `pull: true`). `compose-down`: `… down` (+ `-v`). `wait-http`: on the server, every 3 s `curl -sk -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --max-time 10 [--resolve <host>:<port>:<resolve>] <url>` until the status matches or the timeout (default 2 min); `<port>` is the URL's port, else 443 for `https` and 80 for `http`. | |
| Checks (self-check) | Shared with 1f (`remote.SelfCheck`): `compose-running` (`docker compose ps --all --format json`: every service `running`, and `healthy` when it has a health check), `http-local` (curl as above, once), `cert-expiry` (`openssl x509 -enddate -noout -in <dir>/<file>`: missing → fail; expired → fail; < 14 days → pass with `expiring_days`), `disk-free` (`df -P /`: under `Thresholds.DiskFailPct` free fails, under `DiskWarnPct` passes with `low: true`), `run` (exit 0). `remote.SelfCheck(ctx, c, checks, Thresholds{CertWarnDays, DiskWarnPct, DiskFailPct})`: 1d passes the constants 14 / 10 / 2, 1f passes the settings. `compose-running` parses both output shapes of `docker compose ps --format json` (one JSON array, or one object per line, depending on the Compose version). One SSH session, one command per check. Returns per-check results. In provisioning, all must pass. | |
| endpoints step | Render endpoints, `endpoint.Lookup(type).Check`, display names, replace the server's `servers_endpoints` rows (sealed credential + params). | |
| smoke-test | `proxy.Test` per endpoint, up to 3 attempts 20 s apart; every endpoint must pass. The failure message is the class and error of the last attempt, e.g. "stalled after 16 KB". | |
| activate | One `Write`: server → `active`, health `unknown`, `health_since = now`, `activated_at`, `template_version`, deployment → `succeeded`; record `server.activated{proxy_test: {endpoint: {first_byte_ms, kbps}}, forced: false}`. | |
| Activate anyway | Offered only when `state = failed` and `failed_step = smoke-test`. Strength 2 dialog showing the stored error. One `Write`: as `activate` with `forced: true` (proxy_test holds the failure). | provisioning.md. |
| Cancel | The Job page's Cancel works; the server page shows **Cancel provisioning** while the job runs (strength 1). | |
| Concurrency | Queue `provisioning` has 2 workers (0c); the resource key serializes a server's jobs. | |
| Ports | `servers.Module` exposes `EndpointCatalog()`, `ServerHostnames()`, `ProxyDialer()` (interfaces in `servers/ports.go`), and accepts an optional `UsageReader` (`SetUsage(u UsageReader)`), nil in Phase 1. Other modules get them through `cmd/proxier/main.go` wiring (Phase 2). | modules/servers.md#ports-for-other-modules. |
| Dashboard | New platform interface `module.DashboardDeclarer`. In 1d the servers area shows counts by lifecycle state and the failed servers with their step; 1f extends it. | |
| QR | `ui.QR(text)`: SVG from `rsc.io/qr` (pure Go), quiet zone 4, dark modules in `--text`, on `--surface`; no PNG. | Reused by Phase 2 links. |
| Endpoint URIs on the page | Secret field: masked; **Reveal** (htmx GET, `Cache-Control: no-store`), **Copy**, **QR** (dialog). No event for revealing. | ui/README secret field. |
| Notes | `POST /servers/:id/notes`, ≤ 10 000 chars, `server.notes_changed` only when changed. | |
| Template preview for a server | 1b's preview picker now lists active servers; rendering for a server uses its real context with secrets shown as `•••` unless **Reveal** (admin). | template-authoring.md step 5. |

## Platform changes (in this sub-phase)

- `jobs.System.RetryWithTx` (+ test `TestRetryWithPatchesPayloadAndSecrets` in `jobs/`).
- `sshx.Hop.Password` (+ test `TestPasswordLoginForFirstContact` in `sshx/client_test.go`; the password never reaches a log).
- `sshxtest.Server`: per-user authorized keys and passwords (`AllowPassword(user, pw)`, `AuthorizeKey(user, key)`), `HandleFunc(match, fn)`, and an SFTP root that maps absolute paths into `Dir()`.
- `module.DashboardDeclarer`, `ui.DashboardArea{Order int, Title string, Body templ.Component}`; the dashboard renders module areas after the platform's.
- `ui.QR`; the Job page's step list and live log exported as components (`ui.JobSteps`, `ui.JobLog`) for embedding.
- (The `/jobs?subject=…` and `/activity?subject=…` filters already exist from 0c; nothing to add.)

## Go signatures

### `servers/ports.go`

```go
type ServerEndpoints struct {
	ServerID    int64
	Name        string
	Health      string
	HealthSince time.Time
	Endpoints   []endpoint.Endpoint // with credentials: callers must not log them
}
type EndpointCatalog interface {
	Active(ctx context.Context) ([]ServerEndpoints, error)
	Server(ctx context.Context, id int64) (ServerEndpoints, bool, error)
}
type ServerHostnames interface {
	// Every management and proxy hostname and IP of every non-retired server.
	Hostnames(ctx context.Context) (names []string, ips []netip.Addr, err error)
}
type ProxyDialer interface {
	Dial(ctx context.Context, serverID int64) (proxy.DialFunc, io.Closer, error)
}
type UsageReader interface {
	// Subscriptions and link counts that serve a server (Phase 2).
	Usage(ctx context.Context, serverID int64) (subscriptions []string, links int, err error)
}
```

### `servers/provision`

```go
type Form struct {
	IP, RootPassword string
	SSHPort          int
	LocationID       int64
	TemplateID       int64
	Version          int
	Params           map[string]string
	Notes            string
}
type Summary struct {
	Name, ManagementHostname, ProxyHostname, DNSRecord string
	Endpoints          []string // display names
	SuggestedLocation  int64    // 0 = none
	SuggestedCountry   string
	Errors             settings.FieldErrors
}
type Service struct{ Now func() time.Time /* … */ }
func New(deps Deps) *Service
func (s *Service) Summarize(ctx context.Context, f Form, locationTouched bool) Summary
func (s *Service) Create(ctx context.Context, f Form, actor string) (serverID int64, err error) // settings.FieldErrors on refusal
func (s *Service) Retry(ctx context.Context, serverID int64, rootPassword string, overwriteDNS bool, actor string) (jobID int64, err error)
func (s *Service) ActivateAnyway(ctx context.Context, serverID int64, actor string) error
func (s *Service) JobType() jobs.Type
```

### `servers/serverstest`

```go
// VPS is a fake Debian/Ubuntu server: users, sudoers, sshd drop-ins, apt,
// Docker, ufw, files under dir, compose services, a certificate, disk and
// network counters. It answers remote's commands and keeps state between them.
type VPS struct {
	*sshxtest.Server
	OS, Arch      string        // "debian-12", "amd64"
	RootPassword  string
	PortsInUse    map[int]string // 443 → "nginx (pid 812)"
	Docker        bool
	Services      map[string]string // "xray" → "running"
	CertDaysLeft  int               // <0 expired; missing when CertMissing
	DiskFreePct   float64
	// Faults for edge cases:
	BreakKeyLoginAfterSSHD bool
	BreakAuthorizedKeys    bool
	VisudoFails            bool
	RequireTTY             bool
	ComposeUpFails         string // message
	CertbotRateLimited     bool
	// …
}
func NewVPS(t testing.TB) *VPS
func (v *VPS) File(path string) ([]byte, bool) // what was uploaded
func (v *VPS) Files(dir string) []string

// Harness wires the servers module with a temp DB, jobstest, a fake
// Cloudflare, a fake resolver, proxytest and a VPS whose endpoint the
// proxy test can reach.
type Harness struct{ /* … */ }
func NewHarness(t testing.TB) *Harness
```

The fake's endpoint for the smoke test: the harness points `proxy.Options.Resolve` for the server's proxy hostname at `proxytest.Server`, whose UUID and path are set from the server's generated values once they exist. Faults on the proxy side come from `proxytest`'s modes.

## Routes

| Method, path | What |
|---|---|
| `GET /servers` | List (1d columns: flag + name, lifecycle, health, IP, proxy hostname, template + version); **New server** |
| `GET /servers/new` | Form |
| `POST /servers/new/summary` | Live summary fragment |
| `POST /servers` | Create → `/servers/:id` |
| `GET /servers/:id` | Overview: header (flag, name, health or lifecycle, actions), identity, template version, endpoints, notes, recent events; provisioning → steps + live log; failed → step, error, Retry / Activate anyway / Retire (Retire disabled until 1g) |
| `GET /servers/:id/retry`, `POST /servers/:id/retry` | Retry form → server page |
| `POST /servers/:id/activate` | Activate anyway (strength 2) |
| `POST /servers/:id/cancel` | Cancel provisioning |
| `GET /servers/:id/endpoints/:key/uri` | Revealed URI (no-store) |
| `GET /servers/:id/endpoints/:key/qr` | QR dialog |
| `POST /servers/:id/notes` | Notes |

Nav: Servers (`g s`). Search: servers by name, IP, hostname. Tabs on the server page: Overview now; Health, Stats, Stack, Jobs, Activity appear with their sub-phases (Jobs and Activity link to the filtered platform pages from 1d).

## Events

Recorded: `server.created`, `server.provisioning_failed` (NotifyIf not cancelled), `server.activated` (renderer: "nl-2 is ready (🇳🇱 Netherlands 2)" / forced text), `server.notes_changed`, `ssh.host_key_pinned` (by sshx).

## Doc changes in the same commit

- `docs/processes/servers/server-provisioning.md`: retry always asks for the password after a preflight/install-access failure; cancelled → failed with no notification; the job does not retry by itself.
- `docs/modules/servers.md`: `base-bootstrap` uses ufw and apt prerequisites `curl ca-certificates openssl ufw`; Docker's published ports and ufw.
- `docs/open-questions.md` question 6: the real-VPS result for XHTTP `stream-up` through nginx `grpc_pass`.

## Checklist

Form, in `provision/form_test.go`:

- [ ] IP already used by active `nl-1` → refused on the form, nothing created — `TestIPAlreadyUsedIsRefused`
- [ ] Archived template, missing version, bad parameters, uncovered hostname, no Cloudflare → field errors, nothing created — `TestFormRefusals`
- [ ] Summary shows name, hostnames, DNS record, endpoint names; the summary request never carries the root password — `TestLiveSummary`
- [ ] IP in NL preselects `nl` when untouched; a chosen location is kept; lookup off → nothing — `TestCountrySuggestion`
- [ ] Create reserves the name, seals the password into the job, records `server.created` — `TestCreateStartsProvisioning`
- [ ] Two servers created in the same location at the same moment → `nl-2` and `nl-3` — `TestConcurrentCreatesGetDistinctNames`
- [ ] A server fails as `nl-2` and is retired; the next in `nl` → `nl-3` — `TestNamesAreNeverReused` (retire by direct store update until 1g; 1g re-runs it through the real flow)

Job, in `provision/provision_test.go` (Harness):

- [ ] Success → active, health `unknown`, DNS record stored, deployment succeeded, endpoints stored, `server.activated` — `TestProvisionSucceeds`
- [ ] Wrong root password → fails at preflight "authentication failed"; retry asks for it again — `TestWrongRootPassword`
- [ ] IP unreachable → fails at preflight; DNS untouched — `TestUnreachableAtPreflight`
- [ ] Port 443 in use → fails at preflight naming the process — `TestPortInUse`
- [ ] Ubuntu 20.04 against the requirement → fails with the OS found — `TestUnsupportedOS`
- [ ] Key login fails after installing keys → install access fails; password kept — `TestKeyLoginFailsAfterInstall`
- [ ] The sshd reload breaks key login → drop-in removed, sshd reloaded, step fails, Proxier can still log in — `TestSSHDChangeIsRolledBack`
- [ ] Docker already installed → sub-step skipped and logged — `TestDockerAlreadyInstalled`
- [ ] A `proxier` user already exists → reused, keys appended without duplicates, sudoers rewritten — `TestExistingDeployUserIsReused`
- [ ] `visudo -cf` fails → install access fails, original sudoers untouched, password kept — `TestBadSudoersIsNotInstalled`
- [ ] `sudo -n true` fails (requiretty) → install access fails with sudo's message — `TestSudoRequiresTTY`
- [ ] The password is erased after install access; it never appears in the log, events or the page — `TestRootPasswordIsErased`
- [ ] Personal keys are installed for `proxier` — `TestPersonalKeysInstalled`
- [ ] Conflicting A record → DNS step fails naming its value; Retry with Overwrite replaces it — `TestDNSConflictThenOverwrite`
- [ ] DNS not visible after 10 min → DNS step fails; Retry resumes at DNS without a second record — `TestDNSWaitTimeoutThenRetry`
- [ ] Let's Encrypt rate limit → install fails with certbot's message — `TestCertbotRateLimited`
- [ ] Restart during base bootstrap → resumes there, running it again is harmless — `TestResumeAtBaseBootstrap`
- [ ] Self-check passes, every smoke-test attempt stalls after 16 KB → failed at smoke test with Retry, Activate anyway, Retire offered — `TestSmokeTestStalls`
- [ ] Activate anyway → active, `server.activated{forced: true}` — `TestActivateAnyway`
- [ ] A failure at the install step → Activate anyway not offered (page and handler) — `TestActivateAnywayOnlyAfterSmokeTest`
- [ ] Cancel during DNS → job cancelled, server failed, DNS record kept, no notification — `TestCancelDuringDNS`
- [ ] Retry uses the server's version even after the default moved on — `TestRetryKeepsVersion`
- [ ] Generated values and secret parameters are redacted in the job log — `TestProvisionLogIsRedacted`
- [ ] A retry of a failure after install access does not ask for the password — `TestRetryAfterAccessNeedsNoPassword`
- [ ] Fails at `install` after `upload-files`; Retry → the same deployment is reopened and ends `succeeded`; it is the server's current files — `TestRetryReopensDeployment`
- [ ] A restart right after the password was erased → `install-access` resumes through the key login, no password needed — `TestInstallAccessResumesAfterPasswordErased`
- [ ] The seed's install list: `base-bootstrap` and `upload-files` run once as job steps; the `install` step runs `issue-cert.sh`, `compose-up`, `wait-http` in order — `TestInstallStepsMapToJobSteps`

Remote, in `remote/`:

- [ ] Quoting survives quotes, spaces, `$`, newlines — `quote_test.go` `TestQuote`
- [ ] Upload removes only files the previous deployment had; `certbot/` untouched — `upload_test.go` `TestUploadRemovesOnlyOwnFiles`
- [ ] Each check passes and fails as specified (compose states in both JSON shapes, http status, cert missing / expired / 10 days, disk 1 % / 5 % / 50 % with the given thresholds, custom run) — `checks_test.go` `TestSelfChecks`
- [ ] `wait-http` resolves with the URL's port (`https://h:8443/` → `--resolve h:8443:127.0.0.1`) — `steps_test.go` `TestWaitHTTPResolvePort`

Pages, in `pages/servers_test.go`:

- [ ] Server page during provisioning shows steps and the live log; when failed shows step, error and the right actions — `TestServerPageStates`
- [ ] Reveal returns the URI with `no-store`; the masked page never contains it — `TestEndpointURIReveal`
- [ ] QR dialog renders an SVG — `TestEndpointQR`
- [ ] Notes save records `server.notes_changed` once — `TestServerNotes`
- [ ] **New location** from the form creates it and selects it — `TestNewLocationFromForm`

Ports:

- [ ] `EndpointCatalog.Active` lists only active servers with endpoints and health — `ports_test.go` `TestEndpointCatalog`
- [ ] `ServerHostnames` lists every non-retired server's names and IPs — `ports_test.go` `TestServerHostnames`

Manual, recorded in As built:

- [ ] A real VPS (Debian 12 or Ubuntu 24.04) provisioned from the seed through the UI; the URI works in a phone app; open question 6's second half answered.

## As built

(Filled in at the end of 1d.)
